name: letter-box
description: Self-hosted macOS email client with NestJS sync backend and optional local Ollama tagging
author: Evgeniy Markitan

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,desktop -c blue,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api -w @letter-box/server" "npm run dev:worker -w @letter-box/server" "npm run dev -w @letter-box/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @letter-box/server && npm run build -w @letter-box/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @letter-box/server && npm run typecheck -w @letter-box/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac -w @letter-box/desktop
